differences.current_text: And these are the wordes of the booke, which Baruch the sonne of Nerias, the sonne of Maasias, the sonne of Sedecias, the sonne of Asadias, the son of Chelcias, wrote in Babylon,
differences.source_text: And these are the words of the book, which Baruch the son of Nerias, the son of Maasias, the son of Sedecias, the son of Asadias, the son of Chelcias, wrote in Babylon,

differences.current_text: In the fift yere, and in the seuenth day of the moneth, what time as the Caldeans tooke Ierusalem, and burnt it with fire.
differences.source_text: In the fifth year, and in the seventh day of the month, what time as the Chaldeans took Jerusalem, and burnt it with fire.

differences.current_text: And Baruch did reade the words of this booke, in the hearing of Iechonias, the sonne of Ioachim king of Iuda, and in the eares of all the people, that came to  the booke.
differences.source_text: And Baruch did read the words of this book in the hearing of Jechonias the son of Joachim king of Juda, and in the ears of all the people that came to hear the book,

differences.current_text: And in the hearing of the nobles, and of the kings sonnes, and in the hearing of the Elders, and of all the people from the lowest vnto the highest, euen of all them that dwelt at Babylon, by the riuer Sud.
differences.source_text: And in the hearing of the nobles, and of the king’s sons, and in the hearing of the elders, and of all the people, from the lowest unto the highest, even of all them that dwelt at Babylon by the river Sud.

differences.current_text: They made also a collection of money, according to euery mans power.
differences.source_text: They made also a collection of money according to every man’s power:

differences.current_text: And they sent it to Ierusalem vnto Ioachim the hie Priest the sonne of Chelcias, sonne of Salom, and to the Priestes, and to all the people which were found with him at Ierusalem,
differences.source_text: And they sent it to Jerusalem unto Joachim the high priest, the son of Chelcias, son of Salom, and to the priests, and to all the people which were found with him at Jerusalem,

differences.current_text: At the same time, when he receiued the vessels of the house of the Lord that were caried out of the Temple, to returne them into the land of Iuda the tenth day of the moneth Siuan,  siluer vessels, which Sedecias the sonne of Iosias king of Iuda had made,
differences.source_text: At the same time when he received the vessels of the house of the Lord, that were carried out of the temple, to return them into the land of Juda, the tenth day of the month Sivan, namely, silver vessels, which Sedecias the son of Josias king of Jada had made,

differences.current_text: After that Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had caried away Iechonias, and the Princes, and the captiues, and the mightie men, and the people of the land from Ierusalem, and brought them vnto Babylon:
differences.source_text: After that Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had carried away Jechonias, and the princes, and the captives, and the mighty men, and the people of the land, from Jerusalem, and brought them unto Babylon.

differences.current_text: And they said, Behold, we haue sent you money, to buy you burnt offerings, and sinne offerings, and incense, and prepare yee Manna, and offer vpon the Altar of the Lord our God,
differences.source_text: And they said, Behold, we have sent you money to buy you burnt offerings, and sin offerings, and incense, and prepare ye manna, and offer upon the altar of the Lord our God;

differences.current_text: And pray for the life of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and for the life of Balthasar his sonne, that their dayes may be vpon earth as the dayes of heauen.
differences.source_text: And pray for the life of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and for the life of Balthasar his son, that their days may be upon earth as the days of heaven:

differences.current_text: And the Lord wil giue vs strength, and lighten our eyes, and we shall liue vnder the shadow of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and vnder the shadow of Balthasar his sonne, and wee shall serue them many dayes, and finde fauour in their sight.
differences.source_text: And the Lord will give us strength, and lighten our eyes, and we shall live under the shadow of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and under the shadow of Balthasar his son, and we shall serve them many days, and find favour in their sight.

differences.current_text: Pray for vs also vnto the Lord our God, (for wee haue sinned against the Lord our God, and vnto this day the fury of the Lord, and his wrath is not turned from vs)
differences.source_text: Pray for us also unto the Lord our God, for we have sinned against the Lord our God; and unto this day the fury of the Lord and his wrath is not turned from us.

differences.current_text: And yee shall reade this booke, which we haue sent vnto you, to make confession in the house of the Lord, vpon the feasts and solemne dayes.
differences.source_text: And ye shall read this book which we have sent unto you, to make confession in the house of the Lord, upon the feasts and solemn days.

differences.current_text: And yee shall say, To the Lord our God belongeth righteousnesse, but vnto vs the confusion of faces, as it is come to passe this day vnto them of Iuda, & to the inhabitants of Ierusalem,
differences.source_text: And ye shall say, To the Lord our God belongeth righteousness, but unto us the confusion of faces, as it is come to pass this day, unto them of Juda, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem,

differences.current_text: And to our kings, and to our princes, and to our Priests, and to our Prophets, and to our fathers.
differences.source_text: And to our kings, and to our princes, and to our priests, and to our prophets, and to our fathers:

differences.current_text: For wee haue sinned before the Lord,
differences.source_text: For we have sinned before the Lord,

differences.current_text: And disobeyed him, and haue not hearkened vnto the voice of the Lord our God, to walke in the commaundements that he gaue vs openly:
differences.source_text: And disobeyed him, and have not hearkened unto the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in the commandments that he gave us openly:

differences.current_text: Since the day that the Lorde brought our forefathers out of the land of Egypt, vnto this present day, wee haue beene disobedient vnto the Lord our God, and we haue beene negligent in not hearing his voice.
differences.source_text: Since the day that the Lord brought our forefathers out of the land of Egypt, unto this present day, we have been disobedient unto the Lord our God, and we have been negligent in not hearing his voice.

differences.current_text: Wherefore the euils cleaued vnto vs, and the curse which the Lord appointed by Moses his seruant, at the time that he brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt, to giue vs a land that floweth with milke and honie, like as it is to see this day.
differences.source_text: Wherefore the evils cleaved unto us, and the curse, which the Lord appointed by Moses his servant at the time that he brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt, to give us a land that floweth with milk and honey, like as it is to see this day.

differences.current_text: Neuerthelesse we haue not hearkened vnto the voice of the Lord our God, according vnto all the wordes of the Prophets, whom he sent vnto vs.
differences.source_text: Nevertheless we have not hearkened unto the voice of the Lord our God, according unto all the words of the prophets, whom he sent unto us:

differences.current_text: But euery man followed the imagination of his owne wicked heart, to serue strange gods, and to doe euill in the sight of the Lord our God.
differences.source_text: But every man followed the imagination of his own wicked heart, to serve strange gods, and to do evil in the sight of the Lord our God.

differences.current_text: Therefore the Lord hath made good his worde, which hee pronounced against vs, and against our Iudges that iudged Israel, and against our kings, and against our princes, and against the men of Israel and Iuda,
differences.source_text: Therefore the Lord hath made good his word, which he pronounced against us, and against our judges that judged Israel, and against our kings, and against our princes, and against the men of Israel and Juda,

differences.current_text: To bring vpon vs great plagues, such as neuer happened vnder the whole heauen, as it came to passe in Ierusalem, according to the things that were written in the Law of Moses,
differences.source_text: To bring upon us great plagues, such as never happened under the whole heaven, as it came to pass in Jerusalem, according to the things that were written in the law of Moses;

differences.current_text: That a man should eat the flesh of his owne sonne, and the flesh of his owne daughter.
differences.source_text: That a man should eat the flesh of his own son, and the flesh of his own daughter.

differences.current_text: Moreouer, he hath deliuered them to be in subiection to all the kingdomes that are round about vs, to be as a reproch and desolation among all the people round about, where the Lord hath scattered them.
differences.source_text: Moreover he hath delivered them to be in subjection to all the kingdoms that are round about us, to be as a reproach and desolation among all the people round about, where the Lord hath scattered them.

differences.current_text: Thus wee were cast downe and not exalted, because wee haue sinned against the Lord our God, and haue not beene obedient vnto his voice.
differences.source_text: Thus we were cast down, and not exalted, because we have sinned against the Lord our God, and have not been obedient unto his voice.

differences.current_text: To the Lord our God appertaineth righteousnesse: but vnto vs and to our fathers open shame, as appeareth this day.
differences.source_text: To the Lord our God appertaineth righteousness: but unto us and to our fathers open shame, as appeareth this day.

differences.current_text: For all these plagues are come vpon vs, which the Lord hath pronounced against vs,
differences.source_text: For all these plagues are come upon us, which the Lord hath pronounced against us

differences.current_text: Yet haue we not prayed before the Lord, þ we might turne euery one from the imaginations of his wicked heart.
differences.source_text: Yet have we not prayed before the Lord, that we might turn every one from the imaginations of his wicked heart.

differences.current_text: Wherefore the Lord watched ouer vs for euill, and the Lord hath brought it vpon vs: for the Lord is righteous in all his works, which he hath commanded vs.
differences.source_text: Wherefore the Lord watched over us for evil, and the Lord hath brought it upon us: for the Lord is righteous in all his works which he hath commanded us.

differences.current_text: Yet we haue not hearkened vnto his voice, to walk in the cōmandements of the Lord, that he hath set before vs.
differences.source_text: Yet we have not hearkened unto his voice, to walk in the commandments of the Lord, that he hath set before us.

differences.current_text: And now O Lord God of Israel, that hast brought thy people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and high arme, and with signes & with wonders, & with great power, and hast gotten thy selfe a name, as appeareth this day:
differences.source_text: And now, O Lord God of Israel, that hast brought thy people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and high arm, and with signs, and with wonders, and with great power, and hast gotten thyself a name, as appeareth this day:

differences.current_text: O Lord our God, we haue sinned, we haue done vngodly, wee haue dealt vnrighteously in all thine ordinances.
differences.source_text: O Lord our God, we have sinned, we have done ungodly, we have dealt unrighteously in all thine ordinances.

differences.current_text: Let thy wrath turne from vs: for we are but a few left among the heathen, where thou hast scattered vs.
differences.source_text: Let thy wrath turn from us: for we are but a few left among the heathen, where thou hast scattered us.

differences.current_text: Heare our prayers, O Lord, and our petitions, and deliuer vs for thine owne sake, and giue vs fauour in the sight of them which haue led vs away:
differences.source_text: Hear our prayers, O Lord, and our petitions, and deliver us for thine own sake, and give us favour in the sight of them which have led us away:

differences.current_text: That all the earth may know that thou art þ Lord our God, because Israel & his posterity is called by thy name.
differences.source_text: That all the earth may know that thou art the Lord our God, because Israel and his posterity is called by thy name.

differences.current_text: O Lord looke downe from thy holy house, & consider vs: bow downe thine eare, O Lord, to heare vs.
differences.source_text: O Lord, look down from thine holy house, and consider us: bow down thine ear, O Lord, to hear us.

differences.current_text: Open thine eyes and behold: for the dead that are in the graues, whose soules are taken from their bodies, wil giue vnto the Lord neither praise nor righteousnesse.
differences.source_text: Open thine eyes, and behold; for the dead that are in the graves, whose souls are taken from their bodies, will give unto the Lord neither praise nor righteousness:

differences.current_text: But þ soule that is greatly vexed, which goeth stouping & feeble, and the eyes that faile, and the hungry soule wil giue thee praise & righteousnes O Lord.
differences.source_text: But the soul that is greatly vexed, which goeth stooping and feeble, and the eyes that fail, and the hungry soul, will give thee praise and righteousness, O Lord.

differences.current_text: Therfore wee doe not make our humble supplication before thee, O Lord our God, for the righteousnes of our fathers, and of our kings.
differences.source_text: Therefore we do not make our humble supplication before thee, O Lord our God, for the righteousness of our fathers, and of our kings.

differences.current_text: For thou hast sent out thy wrath & indignation vpon vs, as thou hast spoken by thy seruants þ prophets, saying,
differences.source_text: For thou hast sent out thy wrath and indignation upon us, as thou hast spoken by thy servants the prophets, saying,

differences.current_text: Thus saith the Lord, bow down your shoulders to serue the king of Babylon: so shall ye remaine in the lande that I gaue vnto your fathers.
differences.source_text: Thus saith the Lord, Bow down your shoulders to serve the king of Babylon: so shall ye remain in the land that I gave unto your fathers.

differences.current_text: But if ye will not heare the voice of the Lord to serue þ king of Babylon,
differences.source_text: But if ye will not hear the voice of the Lord, to serve the king of Babylon,

differences.current_text: I will cause to cease out of the cities of Iuda, and from without Ierusalem the voice of mirth, and the voice of ioy: the voice of the bridegrome, and the voice of the bride, and the whole land shall be desolate of inhabitants.
differences.source_text: I will cause to cease out of the cites of Judah, and from without Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of joy, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: and the whole land shall be desolate of inhabitants.

differences.current_text: But we would not hearken vnto thy voyce, to serue the king of Babylon: therefore hast thou made good the wordes that thou spakest by thy seruants the prophets, namely that the bones of our kings, and the bones of our fathers should be taken out of their places.
differences.source_text: But we would not hearken unto thy voice, to serve the king of Babylon: therefore hast thou made good the words that thou spakest by thy servants the prophets, namely, that the bones of our kings, and the bones of our fathers, should be taken out of their place.

differences.current_text: And loe, they are cast out to the heat of the day, and to the frost of the night, and they died in great miseries, by famine, by sword, and by pestilence.
differences.source_text: And, lo, they are cast out to the heat of the day, and to the frost of the night, and they died in great miseries by famine, by sword, and by pestilence.

differences.current_text: And the house which is called by thy name (hast thou laid waste) as it is to be seene this day, for the wickednesse of the house of Israel, and the house of Iuda.
differences.source_text: And the house which is called by thy name hast thou laid waste, as it is to be seen this day, for the wickedness of the house of Israel and the house of Juda.

differences.current_text: O Lord our God, thou hast dealt with vs after all thy goodnesse, and according to all that great mercie of thine.
differences.source_text: O Lord our God, thou hast dealt with us after all thy goodness, and according to all that great mercy of thine,

differences.current_text: As thou spakest by thy seruant Moses in the day when thou didst command him to write thy Law, before the children of Israel, saying,
differences.source_text: As thou spakest by thy servant Moses in the day when thou didst command him to write the law before the children of Israel, saying,

differences.current_text: If ye will not heare my voyce, surely this very great multitude shalbe turned into a smal  among the nations, where I will scatter them.
differences.source_text: If ye will not hear my voice, surely this very great multitude shall be turned into a small number among the nations, where I will scatter them.

differences.current_text: For I knew that they would not heare me: because it is a stiffenecked people: but in the land of their captiuities, they shall remember themselues,
differences.source_text: For I knew that they would not hear me, because it is a stiffnecked people: but in the land of their captivities they shall remember themselves.

differences.current_text: And shall know that I am the Lord their God: For I giue them an heart, and eares to heare.
differences.source_text: And shall know that I am the Lord their God: for I will give them an heart, and ears to hear:

differences.current_text: And they shal praise me in the land of their captiuitie, and thinke vpon my name,
differences.source_text: And they shall praise me in the land of their captivity, and think upon my name,

differences.current_text: And returne from their stiffe neck, and from their wicked deeds: for they shal remember the way of their fathers which sinned before the Lord.
differences.source_text: And return from their stiff neck, and from their wicked deeds: for they shall remember the way of their fathers, which sinned before the Lord.

differences.current_text: And I will bring them againe into the land which I promised with an oath vnto their fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Iacob, and they shall bee lords of it, and I will increase them, and they shall not be diminished.
differences.source_text: And I will bring them again into the land which I promised with an oath unto their fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and they shall be lords of it: and I will increase them, and they shall not be diminished.

differences.current_text: And I will make an euerlasting couenant with them, to be their God, and they shall be my people: and I will no more driue my people of Israel out of the land that I haue giuen them.
differences.source_text: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them to be their God, and they shall be my people: and I will no more drive my people of Israel out of the land that I have given them.

differences.current_text: O Lord almighty, God of Israel, the soule in anguish, the troubled spirit crieth vnto thee.
differences.source_text: O Lord Almighty, God of Israel, the soul in anguish the troubled spirit, crieth unto thee.

differences.current_text: Heare O Lord, and haue mercy: for thou art mercifull, and haue pitty vpon vs, because we haue sinned before thee.
differences.source_text: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy; as thou art merciful: and have pity upon us, because we have sinned before thee.

differences.current_text: For thou endurest for euer, and we perish vtterly.
differences.source_text: For thou endurest for ever, and we perish utterly.

differences.current_text: O Lord almighty, thou God of Israel, heare now the prayers of the dead Israelites, and of their children, which haue sinned before thee, and not hearkened vnto the voice of thee their God: for the which cause these plagues cleaue vnto vs.
differences.source_text: O Lord Almighty, thou God of Israel, hear now the prayers of the dead Israelites, and of their children, which have sinned before thee, and not hearkened unto the voice of thee their God: for the which cause these plagues cleave unto us.

differences.current_text: Remember not the iniquities of our forefathers: but thinke vpon thy power and thy name, now at this time.
differences.source_text: Remember not the iniquities of our forefathers: but think upon thy power and thy name now at this time.

differences.current_text: And for this cause thou hast put thy feare in our hearts, to the intent that we should call vpon thy name, and praise thee in our captiuity: for we haue called to minde all the iniquity of our forefathers that sinned before thee.
differences.source_text: And for this cause thou hast put thy fear in our hearts, to the intent that we should call upon thy name, and praise thee in our captivity: for we have called to mind all the iniquity of our forefathers, that sinned before thee.

differences.current_text: Behold, we are yet this day in our captiuity, where thou hast scattered vs, for a reproch and a curse, and to be subiect to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers which departed from the Lord our God.
differences.source_text: Behold, we are yet this day in our captivity, where thou hast scattered us, for a reproach and a curse, and to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, which departed from the Lord our God.

differences.current_text: Heare, Israel, the commandements of life, giue eare to vnderstand wisedome.
differences.source_text: Hear, Israel, the commandments of life: give ear to understand wisdom.

differences.current_text: How happeneth it, Israel, that thou art in thine enemies land, that thou art waxen old in a strange countrey, that thou art defiled with the dead?
differences.source_text: How happeneth it Israel, that thou art in thine enemies’ land, that thou art waxen old in a strange country, that thou art defiled with the dead,

differences.current_text: That thou art counted with them that goe downe into the graue?
differences.source_text: That thou art counted with them that go down into the grave?

differences.current_text: Thou hast forsaken the fountaine of wisedome.
differences.source_text: Thou hast forsaken the fountain of wisdom.

differences.current_text: For if thou hadst walked in the way of God, thou shouldest haue dwelled in peace for euer.
differences.source_text: For if thou hadst walked in the way of God, thou shouldest have dwelled in peace for ever.

differences.current_text: Learne where is wisedome, where is strength, where is vnderstanding, that thou mayest know also where is length of daies, and life, where is the light of the eyes and peace.
differences.source_text: Learn where is wisdom, where is strength, where is understanding; that thou mayest know also where is length of days, and life, where is the light of the eyes, and peace.

differences.current_text: Where are the princes of the heathen become, and such as ruled the beasts vpon the earth.
differences.source_text: Where are the princes of the heathen become, and such as ruled the beasts upon the earth;

differences.current_text: They that had their pastime with the foules of the aire, and they that hoorded vp siluer and gold wherein men trust, and made no end of their getting?
differences.source_text: They that had their pastime with the fowls of the air, and they that hoarded up silver and gold, wherein men trust, and made no end of their getting?

differences.current_text: For they that wrought in siluer, and were so carefull, and whose workes are vnsearchable,
differences.source_text: For they that wrought in silver, and were so careful, and whose works are unsearchable,

differences.current_text: They are vanished, and gone downe to the graue, and others are come vp in their steads.
differences.source_text: They are vanished and gone down to the grave, and others are come up in their steads.

differences.current_text: Young men haue seene light, and dwelt vpon the earth: but the way of knowledge haue they not knowen,
differences.source_text: Young men have seen light, and dwelt upon the earth: but the way of knowledge have they not known,

differences.current_text: Nor vnderstood the pathes thereof; nor laid hold of it: their children were farre off from that way.
differences.source_text: Nor understood the paths thereof, nor laid hold of it: their children were far off from that way.

differences.current_text: It hath not beene heard of in Chanaan: neither hath it beene seene in Theman.
differences.source_text: It hath not been heard of in Chanaan, neither hath it been seen in Theman.

differences.current_text: The Agarenes that seek wisdome vpon earth, the marchants of Merran, and of Theman, the authors of fables, and searchers out of vnderstanding: none of these haue knowen the way of wisedome, or remember her pathes.
differences.source_text: The Agarenes that seek wisdom upon earth, the merchants of Meran and of Theman, the authors of fables, and searchers out of understanding; none of these have known the way of wisdom, or remember her paths.

differences.current_text: O Israel, how great is the house of God? and how large is the place of his possession?
differences.source_text: O Israel, how great is the house of God! and how large is the place of his possession!

differences.current_text: Great, and hath none end: high, and vnmeasurable.
differences.source_text: Great, and hath none end; high, and unmeasurable.

differences.current_text: There were the gyants, famous from the beginning, that were of so great stature, and so expert in warre.
differences.source_text: There were the giants famous from the beginning, that were of so great stature, and so expert in war.

differences.current_text: Those did not the Lord chuse, neither gaue he the way of knowledge vnto them.
differences.source_text: Those did not the Lord choose, neither gave he the way of knowledge unto them:

differences.current_text: But they were destroyed, because they had no wisedome, and perished through their owne foolishnesse.
differences.source_text: But they were destroyed, because they had no wisdom, and perished through their own foolishness.

differences.current_text: Who hath gone vp into heauen and taken her, and brought her downe from the clouds?
differences.source_text: Who hath gone up into heaven, and taken her, and brought her down from the clouds?

differences.current_text: Who hath gone ouer the Sea, and found her, & wil bring her for pure gold?
differences.source_text: Who hath gone over the sea, and found her, and will bring her for pure gold?

differences.current_text: But he that knoweth all things, knoweth her, and hath found her out with his vnderstanding: he that prepared the earth for euermore, hath filled it with fourefooted beasts.
differences.source_text: But he that knoweth all things knoweth her, and hath found her out with his understanding: he that prepared the earth for evermore hath filled it with fourfooted beasts:

differences.current_text: He that sendeth forth light, and it goeth: calleth it againe, and it obeyeth him with feare.
differences.source_text: He that sendeth forth light, and it goeth, calleth it again, and it obeyeth him with fear.

differences.current_text: The starres shined in their watches, and reioyced: when he calleth them, they say, Here we be, and so with cheerefulnesse they shewed light vnto him that made them.
differences.source_text: The stars shined in their watches, and rejoiced: when he calleth them, they say, Here we be; and so with cheerfulness they shewed light unto him that made them.

differences.current_text: This is our God, and there shall none other be accounted of in comparison of him.
differences.source_text: This is our God, and there shall none other be accounted of in comparison of him

differences.current_text: He hath found out all the way of knowledge, and hath giuen it vnto Iacob his seruant, & to Israel his beloued.
differences.source_text: He hath found out all the way of knowledge, and hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved.

differences.current_text: Afterward did he shew himselfe vpon earth, and conuersed with men.
differences.source_text: Afterward did he shew himself upon earth, and conversed with men.

differences.current_text: This is the Booke of the commandements of God: and the Law that endureth for euer: all they that keepe it shall come to life: but such as leaue it, shall die.
differences.source_text: This is the book of the commandments of God, and the law that endureth for ever: all they that keep it shall come to life; but such as leave it shall die.

differences.current_text: Turne thee, O Iacob, & take heed of it: walke in the presence of the light therof, that thou mayest be illuminated.
differences.source_text: Turn thee, O Jacob, and take hold of it: walk in the presence of the light thereof, that thou mayest be illuminated.

differences.current_text: Giue not thine honour to another, nor the things that are profitable vnto thee, to a strange nation.
differences.source_text: Give not thine honour to another, nor the things that are profitable unto thee to a strange nation.

differences.current_text: O Israel, happie are wee: for things that are pleasing to God, are made knowen vnto vs.
differences.source_text: O Israel, happy are we: for things that are pleasing to God are made known unto us.

differences.current_text: Be of good cheare, my people, the memoriall of Israel.
differences.source_text: Be of good cheer, my people, the memorial of Israel.

differences.current_text: Ye were sold to the nations, not for  destruction: but because you moued God to wrath, ye were deliuered vnto the enemies.
differences.source_text: Ye were sold to the nations, not for [your] destruction: but because ye moved God to wrath, ye were delivered unto the enemies.

differences.current_text: For yee prouoked him that made you, by sacrificing vnto deuils, and not to God.
differences.source_text: For ye provoked him that made you by sacrificing unto devils, and not to God.

differences.current_text: Ye haue forgotten the euerlasting God, that brought you vp, and ye haue grieued Ierusalem that noursed you.
differences.source_text: Ye have forgotten the everlasting God, that brought you up; and ye have grieved Jerusalem, that nursed you.

differences.current_text: For when shee saw the wrath of God cōming vpon you, she said; Hearken, O ye that dwell about Sion: God hath brought vpō me great mourning.
differences.source_text: For when she saw the wrath of God coming upon you, she said, Hearken, O ye that dwell about Sion: God hath brought upon me great mourning;

differences.current_text: For I saw the captiuitie of my sonnes and daughters, which the euerlasting brought vpon them.
differences.source_text: For I saw the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting brought upon them.

differences.current_text: With ioy did I nourish them: but sent them away with weeping and mourning.
differences.source_text: With joy did I nourish them; but sent them away with weeping and mourning.

differences.current_text: Let no man reioyce ouer me a widow, and forsaken of many, who for the sinnes of my children, am left desolate: because they departed from the Law of God.
differences.source_text: Let no man rejoice over me, a widow, and forsaken of many, who for the sins of my children am left desolate; because they departed from the law of God.

differences.current_text: They knew not his statutes, nor walked in the waies of his Commandements, nor trode in the pathes of discipline in his righteousnesse.
differences.source_text: They knew not his statutes, nor walked in the ways of his commandments, nor trod in the paths of discipline in his righteousness.

differences.current_text: Let them that dwell about Sion come, and remember ye the captiuity of my sonnes and daughters, which the euerlasting hath brought vpon them.
differences.source_text: Let them that dwell about Sion come, and remember ye the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting hath brought upon them.

differences.current_text: For he hath brought a nation vpon them from far: a shamelesse nation, and of a strange language, who neither reuerenced old man, nor pitied childe.
differences.source_text: For he hath brought a nation upon them from far, a shameless nation, and of a strange language, who neither reverenced old man, nor pitied child.

differences.current_text: These haue caried away the deare beloued children of the widow, and left her that was alone, desolate without daughters.
differences.source_text: These have carried away the dear beloved children of the widow, and left her that was alone desolate without daughters.

differences.current_text: But what can I helpe you?
differences.source_text: But what can I help you?

differences.current_text: For he that brought these plagues vpon you, will deliuer you from the hands of your enemies.
differences.source_text: For he that brought these plagues upon you will deliver you from the hands of your enemies.

differences.current_text: Goe your way, O my children, goe your way: for I am left desolate.
differences.source_text: Go your way, O my children, go your way: for I am left desolate.

differences.current_text: I haue put off the clothing of peace, and put vpon me the sackcloth of my prayer. I will cry vnto the euerlasting in my dayes.
differences.source_text: I have put off the clothing of peace, and put upon me the sackcloth of my prayer: I will cry unto the Everlasting in my days.

differences.current_text: Be of good cheare, O my children, cry vnto the Lord: & he shal deliuer you from the power & hand of the enemies.
differences.source_text: Be of good cheer, O my children, cry unto the Lord, and he will deliver you from the power and hand of the enemies.

differences.current_text: For my hope is in the Euerlasting that hee will saue you, and ioy is come vnto me from the Holy one, because of the mercy which shall soone come vnto you from the euerlasting our Sauiour.
differences.source_text: For my hope is in the Everlasting, that he will save you; and joy is come unto me from the Holy One, because of the mercy which shall soon come unto you from the Everlasting our Saviour.

differences.current_text: For I sent you out with mourning and weeping: but God will giue you to mee againe, with ioy and gladnesse for euer.
differences.source_text: For I sent you out with mourning and weeping: but God will give you to me again with joy and gladness for ever.

differences.current_text: Like as now the neighbours of Sion haue seene your captiuity: so shall they see shortly your saluation from our God, which shall come vpon you with great glory, and brightnesse of the euerlasting.
differences.source_text: Like as now the neighbours of Sion have seen your captivity: so shall they see shortly your salvation from our God which shall come upon you with great glory, and brightness of the Everlasting.

differences.current_text: My children, suffer patiently the wrath that is come vpon you from God: for thine enemy hath persecuted thee: but shortly thou shalt see his destruction, & shalt tread vpon his necke.
differences.source_text: My children, suffer patiently the wrath that is come upon you from God: for thine enemy hath persecuted thee; but shortly thou shalt see his destruction, and shalt tread upon his neck.

differences.current_text: My delicate ones haue gone rough wayes, and were taken away as a flocke caught of the enemies.
differences.source_text: My delicate ones have gone rough ways, and were taken away as a flock caught of the enemies.

differences.current_text: Be of good comfort, O my children, and cry vnto God: for you shall be remembred of him that brought these things vpon you.
differences.source_text: Be of good comfort, O my children, and cry unto God: for ye shall be remembered of him that brought these things upon you.

differences.current_text: For as it was your minde to goe astray from God: so being returned seeke him ten times more.
differences.source_text: For as it was your mind to go astray from God: so, being returned, seek him ten times more.

differences.current_text: For he that hath brought these plagues vpon you, shall bring you euerlasting ioy againe with your saluation.
differences.source_text: For he that hath brought these plagues upon you shall bring you everlasting joy with your salvation.

differences.current_text: Take a good heart, O Ierusalem: for hee that gaue thee that name, will comfort thee.
differences.source_text: Take a good heart, O Jerusalem: for he that gave thee that name will comfort thee.

differences.current_text: Miserable are they that afflicted thee, and reioyced at thy fall.
differences.source_text: Miserable are they that afflicted thee, and rejoiced at thy fall.

differences.current_text: Miserable are the cities which thy children serued: miserable is she that receiued thy sonnes.
differences.source_text: Miserable are the cities which thy children served: miserable is she that received thy sons.

differences.current_text: For as shee reioyced at thy ruine, and was glad of thy fall: so shall she be grieued for her owne desolation.
differences.source_text: For as she rejoiced at thy ruin, and was glad of thy fall: so shall she be grieved for her own desolation.

differences.current_text: For I will take away the reioycing of her great multitude, and her pride shalbe turned into mourning.
differences.source_text: For I will take away the rejoicing of her great multitude, and her pride shall be turned into mourning.

differences.current_text: For fire shal come vpon her frō the euerlasting, long to endure: and she shal be inhabited of deuils for a great time.
differences.source_text: For fire shall come upon her from the Everlasting, long to endure; and she shall be inhabited of devils for a great time.

differences.current_text: O Ierusalem, looke about thee toward the East, and behold the ioy that commeth vnto thee from God.
differences.source_text: O Jerusalem, look about thee toward the east, and behold the joy that cometh unto thee from God.

differences.current_text: Loe, thy sonnes come whom thou sentest away: they come gathered together from the East to the West, by the word of the holy One, reioycing in the glory of God.
differences.source_text: Lo, thy sons come, whom thou sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the glory of God.

differences.current_text: Put off, O Ierusalem, the garment of thy mourning and affliction, and put on the comelinesse of the glory that commeth from God for euer.
differences.source_text: Put off, O Jerusalem, the garment of mourning and affliction, and put on the comeliness of the glory that cometh from God for ever.

differences.current_text: Cast about thee a double garment of the righteousnesse which commeth from God, and set a diademe on thine head of the glory of the euerlasting.
differences.source_text: Cast about thee a double garment of the righteousness which cometh from God; and set a diadem on thine head of the glory of the Everlasting.

differences.current_text: For God wil shew thy brightnesse vnto euery countrey vnder heauen.
differences.source_text: For God will shew thy brightness unto every country under heaven.

differences.current_text: For thy name shall bee called of God for euer, The peace of righteousnesse, and the glory of Gods worship.
differences.source_text: For thy name shall be called of God for ever The peace of righteousness, and The glory of God’s worship.

differences.current_text: Arise, O Ierusalem, and stand on high, and looke about toward the East, and behold thy children gathered from the West vnto the East by the word of the holy One, reioycing in the remembrance of God.
differences.source_text: Arise, O Jerusalem, and stand on high, and look about toward the east, and behold thy children gathered from the west unto the east by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the remembrance of God.

differences.current_text: For they departed from thee on foote, and were ledde away of their enemies: but God bringeth them vnto thee exalted with glory, as children of the kingdome.
differences.source_text: For they departed from thee on foot, and were led away of their enemies: but God bringeth them unto thee exalted with glory, as children of the kingdom.

differences.current_text: For God hath appointed that euery high hill, and banks of long continuance should be cast downe, and valleys filled vp, to make euen the ground, that Israel may goe safely in the glory of God.
differences.source_text: For God hath appointed that every high hill, and banks of long continuance, should be cast down, and valleys filled up, to make even the ground, that Israel may go safely in the glory of God,

differences.current_text: Moreouer, euen the woods, & euery sweet smelling tree, shall ouershadow Israel by the commandement of God.
differences.source_text: Moreover even the woods and every sweetsmelling tree shall overshadow Israel by the commandment of God.

differences.current_text: For God shall leade Israel with ioy, in the light of his glory, with the mercy and righteousnes that commeth from him.
differences.source_text: For God shall lead Israel with joy in the light of his glory with the mercy and righteousness that cometh from him.
